components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Glass pill for the main action (Next star, Chart again, Try Again).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.34em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-teal); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 5%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 36px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 15%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 30px -4px var(--color-teal); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-teal); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.34em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-fog); background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-fog) 40%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 36px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--color-starlight); border-color: var(--color-fog); }

components.name: Category Tile
components.description: Glass tile in the category grid with a teal line icon.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 24px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 3%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 12%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 5%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 40px -8px var(--color-teal); } .ds-tile-disc { display: grid; place-content: center; width: 46px; height: 46px; color: var(--color-teal); } .ds-tile-name { font-family: Unbounded, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-starlight); } .ds-tile-sub { font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-fog); }

components.name: Answer Row
components.description: Glass label row with a restyled radio key-dot; correct/wrong/dim locked states.
components.css: .ds-answer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 22px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-weight: 300; font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-starlight); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 3%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 15%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-answer:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-teal) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 26px -6px var(--color-teal); } .ds-answer-dot { flex: none; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Constellation Progress
components.description: Signature progress meter: answered questions light stars, adjacent lit stars connect gold.
components.html: <svg class="ds-constellation" viewBox="0 0 800 64" preserveAspectRatio="none"><line x1="40" y1="24" x2="200" y2="40" class="ds-line-lit"/><line x1="200" y1="40" x2="360" y2="18" class="ds-line"/><circle cx="40" cy="24" r="4.5" class="ds-node-gold"/><circle cx="200" cy="40" r="3" class="ds-node-fog"/><circle cx="360" cy="18" r="4" class="ds-node-now"/><circle cx="520" cy="46" r="3" class="ds-node-future"/></svg>
components.css: .ds-constellation { display: block; width: 100%; height: 64px; overflow: visible; } .ds-line { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 25%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-line-lit { stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-stargold) 60%, transparent); stroke-width: 1; } .ds-node-gold { fill: var(--color-stargold); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--color-stargold)); } .ds-node-fog { fill: var(--color-fog); } .ds-node-now { fill: var(--color-teal); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--color-teal)); animation: ds-pulse 1.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-node-future { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-starlight) 20%, transparent); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

narrative.overview: This is the quiet hour at an observatory: lights down, the dome open, a deep field of stars overhead, and a single instrument glowing softly in front of you. The interface is atmosphere first and controls second. A near-black canvas holds a drifting aurora and a scatter of twinkling stars; the UI sits on top of it in restrained translucent glass, never a solid slab, never a bright card. The signature idea is that your score is not a readout but a drawing: each answered question lights a star in a constellation that assembles itself across the top of the play area, gold for a hit, faded for a miss.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black cosmic canvas with a live aurora + starfield backdrop.
Frameless, translucent-glass surfaces; no opaque cards.
One working accent (teal); gold is earned, never decorative.
Progress rendered as a self-drawing constellation.
Unbounded display with extreme letter-spacing; airy light-weight Outfit body.
Motion is meaningful and eased-out; every animation names an event.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only interactive color. If a control lights up, hovers, focuses, or pulses, it is teal, never gold, violet, or green.

rules.name: The Earned Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only as a consequence of a correct answer or a finished score. It is forbidden as decoration, as a border, or as a hover state.

rules.name: The Wide-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Every uppercase Unbounded label carries at least 0.22em tracking; the wordmark carries 0.55em. Tight uppercase is forbidden.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces cast no drop shadows. If something needs to feel active, it glows; if it needs separation, it uses translucency and blur.

dos: Do keep teal as the only interactive color and gold as reward-only.
Do render foreground surfaces as translucent glass over the live sky.
Do convey depth with glow and translucency, never drop shadows.
Do track uppercase Unbounded labels at 0.22em or wider.
Do map every animation to a real event and ease out; provide a prefers-reduced-motion settle.
Do keep progress available to screen readers via the constellation's live-text fallback.
donts: Don't reintroduce opaque cards or the old white panel; no card grids, and never nest a glass surface inside another.
Don't drift toward generic quiz-app SaaS (Kahoot/Quizizz primary-color cartoon energy).
Don't turn it into a gamified neon casino (coin showers, slot glitz, streak-pressure loops).
Don't let it flatten into a corporate dashboard (Material/Bootstrap gray-on-white card grids).
Don't ship AI slop: no gradient text anywhere (wordmark and finale title are solid color), no decorative glassmorphism, no hero-metric template, no identical card grids.
Don't use #000 or #fff for surfaces or text.
Don't put a colored border-left stripe on any row or callout.
